issues.problem: NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 operating income was about $81.5 billion. $33.0 billion is roughly its fiscal 2024 operating income. The figure also can't be right on its face, because operating income can't be well below net income ($72.9B) unless there are very large non-operating gains, and NVIDIA had none of that size.

data.summary: Most of the figures are correct: revenue of $130.5B, up about 114% from $60.9B, net income of $72.9B, total assets of $111.6B, and cash and cash equivalents of about $8.6B. The operating income figure is wrong. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 operating income was about $81.5B, not $33.0B. The $33.0B number looks like it was taken from fiscal 2024.
